Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that the claim R-0001072, taken on 2016-01-14, for $0.21, requires a document before a decision can be made. The reason for this is that the engine could not decide due to a scan back POS detail being incomplete. The document needed to close the gap is the POS detail for the missing weeks. The dispute deadline is 2016-07-12, and the deadline has not yet passed.

Please provide the required document as soon as possible.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
